visualCharacteristics: A three-column grid of cards, each with a grey tile holding an image and a blue heading with a large highlighted figure, followed by text, arrow links and a row of buttons. The stats variant shows an intro, label/value statistic pairs with large figures, and image-plus-text promotional cards.
contentPattern: One row per card: picture, heading (h3; strong = blue, strong > em = large figure), text paragraphs and link paragraphs. Rows without a heading are button rows (link paragraphs, em = white button). In the stats variant: a single-cell text row is the intro, a two-cell row without a heading is a stat [label][value runs, digits = large figure], and a row with a heading is a card [picture][h3][text][※ note][link].
usage: Use it to present a company's key strengths or statistics as a grid of highlighted cards with links.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for strength or key-figure grids with large highlighted numbers; use plain cards for ordinary image-and-text teasers.
